html:
Quest Giver: Jerome's Bones

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Search through Level 1 of Shadow's Embrace for Jerome Lester's corpses and loot them. Bring anything with his name on it to Jerome in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Jerome's Bones

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Corpse Run, Part 2

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Search through Level 1 of Shadow's Embrace for Jerome Lester's corpses and loot them. Bring anything with his name on it to Jerome in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

You kids today have it *easy*, with yer automatic resurrections and yer banks and such. Back in *my* day, the only way to resurrect was to run through the underlife all the ways back to yer corpse. And if ya wanted yer stuff back, ya had to pick up each item one at a time.

That reminds me...shouldn't I have resurrected by now? I ain't even respawned as a ghost in the underlife.

The auto-res system must be buggy. So...how am I supposed to come back? Maybe if I had my stuff back, that would fix things. By now, I betcha every two-bit Orok probably has his mitts on my gear. Do me a favor, would ya? I left behind a lotta corpses that probably still haven't decayed yet. Search through Level 1 of Shadow's Embrace for any of 'em and bring me back whatever's got my name on it. Name's Jerome Lester, by-the-by. Glad to meetcha.

Turn-in:

Took ya long enough t' get back here. Hey, ya found my gloves! That's swell! I wonder if they still fit?

Objectives:

  • Jerome Lester's Gloves ×1

Client level range: 45–100
